messages:
natalie_cust: Hey team — ACME reports failures across a subset of their Dedicated nodes after they applied a security patch. They're seeing 401s on inference API and gaps in audit events. Customer is asking for an immediate mitigation and timeline.

kumar_support: Can you paste the first 3 errors they send?

natalie_cust: Logs they pasted: 
```
2026-03-15T18:12:03Z ERROR auth: token validation failed: key unwrap error
2026-03-15T18:12:03Z WARN audit: event write timeout (shard 7)
2026-03-15T18:12:03Z ERROR api: response 401 /v1/generate (uid=acme-prod-12)
```

sam_sre: Looks like key unwrap (KEK wrap) failing in our HSM path after the customer's glibc/libcrypto VM update. Could be related to CVE-2026-31415 they've applied.

lauren_ops: Customer says they updated system packages yesterday. They also reported billing spikes when retries happened. Need repro steps and whether this is customer environment-only or our runtime.

maria_pm: ACME is highly regulated — they want audit-proof that data retention/audit logs weren't lost. Prioritize.

kumar_support: Repro checklist I asked them to run: 
1) curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.company/v1/health
2) tail -n 100 /var/log/redwood/audit.log | rg "acme-prod-12"
3) openssl list -provider --verbose (verify libcrypto provider)

natalie_cust: They ran 1/2. Health returns 200 for control nodes, but the failing nodes return 401. audit.log shows a 30s gap exactly when the failures started.

sam_sre: Quick mitigation options: 
- Option A: Rotate tokens for affected customer (short term, forces rewrap) :lock: 
- Option B: Fallback to software crypto path for those nodes (increased latency/cost) 
- Option C: Roll back to previous model-runtime image if the change landed in our agent infra.

lauren_ops: Which is least customer-impacting? Rolling back infra could touch many tenants. Token rotation is scoped but requires ACME to accept reissue. Fallback to software crypto might impact latency SLAs.

kumar_support: I spoke with ACME. They'll accept token rotation if it's quick. They want a reproduction log and a patch ETA.

sam_sre: Repro steps for us to validate in staging: 
```
# simulate their kernel/pkg update
docker run --rm -it --privileged redwood/staging-agent:canary /bin/bash
apt-get update && apt-get install -y libcrypto1.2  # simulate vulnerable/new provider
# run integration smoke
./scripts/integration-test --target acme-prod-12 --auth $TEST_TOKEN
```

lauren_ops: Maria, can you confirm SLAs and whether we can accept a brief software-crypto fallback for that customer's Dedicated pool?

maria_pm: We can authorize a 48h fallback as emergency mitigant. Need engineering confirmation on how to enable per-pool.

sam_sre: We have a per-pool flag: CRYPTO_FALLBACK=soft in the agent config. It's safe but will increase token CPU and add ~25% tail latency. I'll validate on one staging node first.

security-bot: CVE-2026-31415 — remote key unwrap weakness in provider X. Advisory: https://security.example.com/CVE-2026-31415. Recommended: patch libcrypto provider OR use software fallback.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy queued: rollback/runtime-fallback toggle to staging at 2098765468 by @sam_sre

sam_sre: Deployed fallback to staging node. Repro now: initial auth ok, no unwrap errors, audit events persisted.

kumar_support: Forwarding results to ACME and proposing token rotation + 48h fallback while we track vendor patch.

natalie_cust: ACME accepted token rotation + fallback. They asked for ETA on vendor patch and request our mitigation steps in writing for their compliance team.

lauren_ops: Action items: 
- sam_sre: confirm rollback/fallback playbook and submit runbook entry. (ETA 2h)
- security: request ETA from provider and track CVE fixes. (ETA ongoing)
- support (kumar): coordinate token rotation with ACME, capture signed acknowledgement. (ETA 1h)

sam_sre: I'll draft a short runbook in #eng-runtime and paste the mitigation snippet here when done.

kumar_support: Noted. Also logging a billing/ticket follow-up for the spikes.

maria_pm: I'll prepare the compliance email template for ACME with mitigation evidence and timeline.

natalie_cust: Thanks team. Please ping me when runbook and evidence are ready so I can send to ACME security contact. :thumbsup:
